english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a living being, including an animal, alien, or other organism.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a living organism, including animals, plants, fungi, and microorganisms.
Use this for a living creature or organism as opposed to an inanimate thing.

examples.english: There may be an unknown creature on Mars.
examples.traditional: 火星上面可能有未知嘅生物。
examples.jyutping: fo2 sing1 soeng6 min6 ho2 nang4 jau5 mei6 zi1 ge3 sang1 mat6

examples.english: This organism can survive in extreme environments.
examples.traditional: 呢種生物可以喺極端環境生存。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zung2 sang1 mat6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gik6 dyun1 waan4 ging2 saang1 cyun4

examples.english: I saw a strange being on the seabed.
examples.traditional: 我喺海底見到一種奇怪嘅生物。
